mapper.select: SELECT id FROM tb_voucher_order WHERE status=1 AND voucher_type_snapshot=0 AND expire_at<=NOW(3) ORDER BY expire_at,id LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_voucher_order SET expire_at=TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE,#{timeoutMinutes},NOW(3)) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status=1 AND voucher_type_snapshot=0 AND expire_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT user_id,status+0 AS status,voucher_type_snapshot,expire_at,CAST(expire_at<=NOW(3) AS SIGNED) AS due FROM tb_voucher_order WHERE id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_voucher_order SET status=4 WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status=1 AND expire_at<=NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM tb_ordinary_order_slot WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND voucher_id=#{voucherId} FOR UPDATE
